request.summary: The maintainer corrected Task Session because an explicit until-blocker request stopped after one passing SWU and returned a manual Refresh step.
request.intent: A single until-blocker request should drive a sequence of separate one-SWU Task Sessions, each with automatic owner-joined closeout, until a genuine blocker.

outputs: The selected SWU implementation passed its focused and full validation.
Required closeout synchronization blocked because its exact target inventory and receipt contract were absent.
The successor SWU was not started.
validation: Task Session closeout-sync record returned block.
execution.notes: The implementation result is pass. The observed gap is lifecycle flow: a deterministic successor exists, but the current invocation surface has no first-class sequential outer loop and the work pack omitted required closeout inputs.

anti_pattern_hits: An explicit whole ordered stream was narrowed to one SWU without routing to a lifecycle owner for the outer loop.
The user received a separate manual Refresh action after deterministic implementation success.

workflow_gaps.summary: Task Session has no formal until-blocker selector or owner route for a sequence of separate sessions.
workflow_gaps.evidence: The canonical flags cap execution at one SWU, while existing telemetry includes successful execute-until-blocker runs.

workflow_gaps.summary: No Spellcraft-owned outer loop consumes a joined closeout receipt and starts the next fresh Task Session.
workflow_gaps.evidence: Task Session correctly forbids recursive next-SWU execution, and prior reflection rejected recursion without installing an alternative composition.

workflow_gaps.summary: Invoke-authored work packs do not necessarily declare the closeout inventory, baseline selectors, validation, and expected owner receipt required by Task Session.
workflow_gaps.evidence: The latest closeout-sync record has all four declared inputs null.

workflow_gaps.summary: The report exposed the workflow-contract defect as the next project blocker instead of distinguishing it from implementation readiness.
workflow_gaps.evidence: Implementation passed, but the overall result was BLOCK solely because the owner closeout contract was absent.
